card.name: Last digit inside multi-digit numbers
card.fires_on: A single digit that is the final or near-final digit of a multi-digit number, such as a patient count denominator, a journal volume or page number, or a dose figure. It is strongest in the middle of fractions like 18/79 and in citation volumes.

modes.label: Patient count fractions
modes.description: Last digit of the denominator in event counts such as n/N followed by a percentage.

modes.label: Citation volume numbers
modes.description: Digit ending a journal volume number in a reference list.

modes.label: Dose and volume figures
modes.description: Digit inside a dose, volume or decimal number in a table or calculation.

card.plain: It fires on a digit that sits inside or ends a longer number, like a patient count or a journal volume.
